COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.
   B. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.
   C. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Responsible Decision Making is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Responsible Decision Making with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Responsible Decision Making.
   C. Say Responsible Decision Making never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Responsible Decision Making as rumours only.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp.
   C. Say Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Concept of Community Service Learning is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Concept of Community Service Learning with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Concept of Community Service Learning.
   C. Say Concept of Community Service Learning never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Concept of Community Service Learning as rumours only.

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

7. Which statement about Intercultural competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Intercultural competence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Intercultural competence as rumours only.
   C. Explain Intercultural competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural competence.

8. Which statement about Self- Awareness in the Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Awareness in the Community never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Self- Awareness in the Community as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Awareness in the Community.
   D. Explain Self- Awareness in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

10. Which statement about Conflict Resolution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Conflict Resolution.
   B. Treat Conflict Resolution as rumours only.
   C. Say Conflict Resolution never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Conflict Resolution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Introduction to Action Research is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to Action Research never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Introduction to Action Research as rumours only.
   C. Explain Introduction to Action Research with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Action Research.

12. Which statement about Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision.
   C. Explain Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Concept of Community Service Learning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Community Needs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills in Education 2.1 Self-Awareness in the  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

3. D — Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. D — Explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A — Explain Concept of Community Service Learning with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A — Explain symbols used on a map

7. C — Explain Intercultural competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. D — Explain Self- Awareness in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A — Nairobi

10. D — Explain Conflict Resolution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. C — Explain Introduction to Action Research with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. C — Explain Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
